entry.title: New: Resolution 229 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO KONA AQUATICS CLUB, INC., TO REPLACE SHADE CANOPIES AT THE KONA COMMUNITY AQUATIC CENTER

Transfers $10,000 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 8)

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 229-23 - 09/06/23
